usageNotes: Use this to verify the Proxmox VE version running on a specific PDM-registered remote before performing operations that may require a minimum PVE version. Requires `Resource.Audit` privilege on the remote resource. The remote must be reachable from PDM at call time; a timeout or unreachable host will surface as an error rather than a stale cached value.
tips: The `version` field is the full pve-manager package version string (e.g. '8.2.4'); `release` is the shorter `x.y` form (e.g. '8.2') useful for major/minor compatibility checks.
The `repoid` field is a short git hash useful when cross-referencing changelogs or bug reports against a specific build.
Remote IDs follow the pattern `[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*` with length 2–32; use list-remotes first if the ID is unknown.
